
Avoid using `localeCompare` without a locale for sorting, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.

```suggestion
    .sort(([left], [right]) => (left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0))
```
